release_notes:
Vortex PT v1.0.5:
• End Anchor Chairs in Tables Always Bottom-Referenced: Regardless of whether drawing annotation is calculated from top or bottom cover datum, all chair schedules (Excel, in-app Schedules tab, DXF sheet table) strictly measure anchor chair heights from the bottom soffit.
• ADAPT Cover Warning Fix: Eliminated false positive concrete cover violation warnings on ADAPT models by evaluating tendon profile elevations against true absolute formwork soffit and TOC.
• 1:1 Custom End Block Scale: Custom DWG/DXF blocks inserted at true 1:1 scale in all directions (X=1, Y=1, Z=1).
• Expanded CAD Viewport & Controlled Properties Width: Dominant CAD canvas layout with constrained inspector panel width on full screen.
• Compact Section Viewer & Invisible Scrollbar: Cross-section viewer with invisible scrollbar, smooth click-and-drag panning, and plan-aligned orientation.
• Fluent/WinUI 3 Dark Scrollbars: Native Windows classic scrollbars replaced with modern styled dark scrollbars across the application.
